rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for advertising or promotional activity intended to attract public interest.

example.english: The new film is coming out next month, so we’re starting publicity now.
example.traditional: 新戲下個月上映，依家開始做宣傳喇。
example.jyutping: san1 hei3 haa6 go3 jyut6 soeng5 jing2 ji1 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 zou6 syun1 cyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the visibility or media exposure of someone or something being in the public spotlight.

example.english: This news story suddenly gave him more publicity.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞令佢突然多咗曝光。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 san1 man4 ling6 keoi5 dat6 jin4 do1 zo2 bou6 gwong1

rows.note: Use this when publicity means the public attention or interest that has been attracted.

example.english: This event attracted a lot of publicity.
example.traditional: 呢個活動成功吸引咗好多公眾關注。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 sing4 gung1 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 zung3 gwaan1 zyu3
